overview.en:
Inspect Freshworks custom apps and versions and manage app package submission workflows.

Review custom application packages and versions before preparing a submission workflow. Keep the application and target version explicit.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
查看 Freshworks 自定义应用及版本，并管理应用包提交流程。

准备提交流程前查看自定义应用包与版本，明确应用和目标版本。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.zh-CN: 准备提交这个应用包的步骤。

descriptions.en: Use Freshworks Developer in Ghast. Inspect Freshworks custom apps and versions and manage app package submission workflows. 查看 Freshworks 自定义应用及版本，并管理应用包提交流程。
